svg.title: Figure 4｜As-Is / To-Be | Compare Workflows
svg.desc: The first 3 nodes form As-Is and the last 4 form To-Be. Arrows stay within each group; no arrow connects old handoff to new input. To-Be node 3 applies only when omissions exist.

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Figure 4｜As-Is / To-Be | Compare Workflows
As-Is 1 | Enter data
Current workflow: enter the application-document data.
As-Is 2 | Check manually
Review the data using a manual checklist.
As-Is 3 | Hand over documents
Assumed pain point: manual checking may overlook required fields.
To-Be 1 | Enter data
Intended workflow: enter the application-document data.
To-Be 2 | Check required fields
Changed step: check whether required fields are complete.
To-Be 3 | Prompt and correct omissions
Conditional step: show omissions and verify completeness after
correction.
To-Be 4 | Preview, export and handoff
Continue after omissions are resolved; improvement still requires
testing.
The first 3 nodes form As-Is and the last 4 form To-Be. Arrows stay
within each group; no arrow connects old handoff to new input. To-Be
node 3 applies only when omissions exist.
